offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures generic and specialty prescription medicines, including injectables, sold to pharmacies, wholesalers, hospitals and health plans. Also sells branded specialty drugs and biosimilars to prescribers and patients.

primary_products.value: generic oral solid medicines; injectable drugs; extended-release drugs; biosimilars; specialty branded drugs

customer_segment.value: B2B: retail pharmacies, wholesale drug distributors, hospitals, health plans and pharmacy benefit managers

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription drugs sold to wholesalers, pharmacies and hospitals

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes generic and specialty drugs in its own plants, sold to wholesalers and pharmacies; brand owner: owns and markets branded specialty drugs sold to prescribers and pharmacies

geography_served.value: global: primarily US, with sales and operations in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: generic oral solids, injectables, specialty branded drugs and biosimilars

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: wholesale drug distributors that supply pharmacies and hospitals; direct sales: national retail chains, hospital systems and health plans

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval and manufacturing licenses from FDA, DEA rules for controlled substances
